items.title: Treasury cash-clearing deadline is under 90 days away (Dec 31, 2026)
items.summary_line: Firms that do not clear today must onboard before year-end, and client activity is already concentrated in a few sponsoring members.
items.what_happened: The SEC's Treasury clearing rule requires eligible cash Treasury trades to be centrally cleared from Dec 31, 2026, and repo from Jun 30, 2027.

transmission.event: SEC compliance date for cash Treasury clearing approaches
transmission.mechanism: Firms that do not clear today onboard through sponsored or agent clearing before year-end
transmission.dtcc_process: GSD onboarding and sponsored volume. The top 5 members already handle about 70–76% of client transactions

items.so_what: A late onboarding rush lands on a small group of sponsoring members, while CME and ICE pitch the same clients.
items.so_now_what: Review onboarding progress weekly against the deadline. Escalate if a large client publicly picks a competing clearinghouse.
items.why_this_line: Tagged FICC · GSD because the rule covers US Treasury cash and repo, which GSD clears.
key_unknowns: How many firms still need to onboard (not public)
Whether the SEC extends the dates again
items.where_we_stand: Competition is real here. CME Securities Clearing is an SEC-approved clearing agency and ICE has publicly signaled a Treasury clearing service, so the question is share of newly cleared activity.
items.shareable_line: With the Dec 31 cash-clearing deadline under 90 days away, sponsored-clearing onboarding at FICC is the item to watch.

items.so_now_what: No decision needed this week. If the spread stays elevated for more than 3 business days, raise it with the liquidity-risk team before month-end.

transmission.mechanism: Faster expected prepayments move TBA prices and widen spreads, raising margin needs for MBSD members
transmission.dtcc_process: MBSD margin and stress losses: worst-case stress loss 24.8% of margin; top 5 members hold about 51% of open positions

items.so_what: MBSD is small next to GSD, but the same market move costs it far more relative to the margin it holds.
items.so_now_what: No action this week. Flag it if spreads widen for a second straight week.

time_phased.next: Monthly TBA settlement dates concentrate exposure
time_phased.later: Prepayment speeds feed through over the next quarters

items.title: Cloud provider outage disrupts several brokers' trading systems
items.summary_line: Late or corrected submissions pile up near settlement cut-off; a few bad inputs rolled NSCC's settlement to the next day in June.
items.what_happened: Several brokers reported trading-system problems linked to a cloud provider outage (sample event).

transmission.event: A major cloud provider outage affects broker systems
transmission.mechanism: Brokers submit trades and instructions late or with errors, so exceptions build near settlement cut-off
transmission.dtcc_process: NSCC net settlement and DTC end-of-day settlement. On Jun 29, 2026, erroneous ETF redemption entries rolled NSCC final settlement into Jun 30

items.so_what: The June rollover showed that a few bad inputs can delay settlement for the whole market.
items.so_now_what: Confirm with operations that this week's late submissions cleared before cut-off. No GM decision unless settlement is delayed.

time_phased.now: Late and corrected submissions this week
time_phased.next: Watch for repeat outages and broker incident reports
time_phased.later: Shorter settlement cycles (T+1, possible 24x5) leave less time to fix errors
